programs.title: Limbo
programs.desc: After a traumatic accident years ago that left others dead, Joe Gastineau has lived a life full of guilt, leading a solitary existence as a fisherman in Alaska. After he meets lounge singer Donna, he starts to fall for her and open up. However, when Joe's half brother returns, asking for help, it sends Joe, Donna and her daughter, Noelle, on a boat ride that will change their lives.

programs.title: Jack Reed: One of Our Own
programs.desc: Framed for his partner's murder, Sgt. Jack Reed embarks on a quest to bring those responsible to justice.

programs.title: Jack Reed: Death and Vengeance
programs.desc: A Chicago police detective links the murders of immigrants to a Russian con artist, not a local labor dispute.

programs.title: Beyond Valkyrie: Dawn of the Fourth Reich
programs.desc: American and British special forces soldiers are sent to extract a resistance fighter from behind the Nazi lines near the end of World War II.

programs.title: Absolute Deception
programs.desc: A female journalist (Emmanuelle Vaugier) teams up with a federal agent (Cuba Gooding Jr.) to uncover the truth behind her husband's death.

programs.title: Planet Action
programs.desc: A look at how celebrities are stepping up to make a difference in the world and hopefully inspiring others to do the same.
